## Software ecosystem for HYDRA-EO

HYDRA-EO uses and extends the **RTM-Suite** ecosystem: coordinated R and
Python implementations for radiative transfer modelling, sensor convolution,
trait inversion and interactive exploration. Use the links below to move
directly between source code, reference documentation and tutorials.

::: {.hero-tags}
::: {.pill-mini}

:::
::: {.pill-mini}

## R packages

::::::: {.card-grid}
:::: {.vbl-card .tool-card-r}
::: {.tool-heading}
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/R-276DC3?logo=r&logoColor=white){alt="R"}

### ToolsRTM
:::

Leaf, canopy and soil radiative transfer models, LUT generation, sensor
convolution and trait inversion. It includes PROSPECT, FLUSPECT, Liberty,
fourSAIL, foursail2, INFORM, MARMIT and SPART workflows.

- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitLab-Source-FC6D26?logo=gitlab&logoColor=white){alt="GitLab source"}](https://gitlab.com/caminoccg/toolsrtm){target="_blank"}
- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-Reference-1587B5?logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white){alt="Reference documentation"}](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/toolsrtm/){target="_blank"}
- [R tutorials →](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/tutorials-overview.html){target="_blank"}
::::

:::: {.vbl-card .tool-card-r}
::: {.tool-heading}
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/R-276DC3?logo=r&logoColor=white){alt="R"}

### SCOPEinR
:::

R interface to SCOPE for coupled canopy radiative transfer,
photosynthesis, energy balance, land-surface temperature and sun-induced
chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF).

- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitLab-Source-FC6D26?logo=gitlab&logoColor=white){alt="GitLab source"}](https://gitlab.com/caminoccg/scopeinr){target="_blank"}
- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-Reference-1587B5?logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white){alt="Reference documentation"}](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/scopeinr/){target="_blank"}
- [R tutorials →](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/tutorials-overview.html#scopeinr){target="_blank"}
::::
:::::::

## Python libraries

::::::: {.card-grid}
:::: {.vbl-card .tool-card-python}
::: {.tool-heading}
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white){alt="Python"}

### toolsrtm
:::

Python port of the ToolsRTM core, including leaf and canopy models, spectral
indices, sensor convolution, STAC satellite retrieval and classical and deep
learning inversion.

- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white){alt="GitHub source"}](https://github.com/CCGCAM/ToolsRTMinPython){target="_blank"}
- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-Reference-1587B5?logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white){alt="Reference documentation"}](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/#docs){target="_blank"}
- [Python tutorials →](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/tutorials-python.html){target="_blank"}
::::

:::: {.vbl-card .tool-card-python}
::: {.tool-heading}
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3776AB?logo=python&logoColor=white){alt="Python"}

### scopeinpython
:::

Python implementation of the SCOPE workflow for batch simulations of
reflectance, fluorescence, photosynthesis, temperature and energy-balance
outputs.

- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-RTM--Suite-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white){alt="RTM-Suite on GitHub"}](https://github.com/CCGCAM/RTM-Suite){target="_blank"}
- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-Reference-1587B5?logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white){alt="Reference documentation"}](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/#docs){target="_blank"}
- [Python tutorials →](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/tutorials-python.html#scopeinpython){target="_blank"}

## Interactive applications

::: {.vbl-card .tool-card-app}
::: {.tool-heading}
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/R_Shiny-Interactive-1F77B4?logo=rstudio&logoColor=white){alt="R Shiny"}

### ToolsRTM.app
:::

Nine point-and-click Shiny applications expose PROSAIL, PROSAIL-BRDF,
MARMIT, SPART, SCOPE, LUT generation, RTM comparison, inversion and STAC
workflows. In R, launch them through `ToolsRTM::get.simulator()`.

- [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Apps-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white){alt="Apps on GitHub"}](https://github.com/CCGCAM/RTM-Suite/tree/main/ToolsRTM.app){target="_blank"}
- [Applications and screenshots →](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/#apps){target="_blank"}
- [Examples and copy-ready code →](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/#examples){target="_blank"}
:::
